unlisted_practices: Provide users transparent control over AI health information filtering parameters.
Clearly communicate to users what health information the AI has suppressed and why.
Allow users to adjust the balance between comprehensive monitoring and cognitive simplicity based on their health literacy and preferences for medical autonomy.
Maintain appropriate human medical expertise and oversight in automated AI health systems so that AI augments rather than compromises clinical judgment.
Validate AI health companions for safety, privacy and security, and maintain ongoing user and clinical oversight.
Conduct further research and collaboration between consumers, clinicians, and developers to optimize AI health companions.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article exploring conceptual AI-enabled assistant 'guardians' to mitigate health information overload and cognitive fatigue for patients.
